name: Split PDF
description: Extract specific pages or page ranges from a document into a separate clean PDF file.

seo.metaTitle: Split PDF — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Extract specific pages or page ranges from a document into a separate clean PDF file. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/pdf-split-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Split PDF processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/pdf-split-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Split PDF upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Split PDF executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-split-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Split PDF upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Split PDF executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-split-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Split PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_split.json or open /tools/pdf-split?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
